items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Playing with Manny was just great. I really enjoyed playing with Manny.

ctx.x: A day in the life of a jazz musician.

Oh Lord. I say, has this happened to all the guys that happens to me? Because me and Rosemary [?] – I said, I got to write a book. This is ridiculous, all this stuff happening. It’s just ridiculous. Playing with Manny was just great. I really enjoyed playing with Manny. Manny had a different type of sound. He used to choose these tunes that would remind you of certain places. We had one that had – was Housman street. Housman street, Thursday afternoon. It was just how people were sitting on their stoops as you…
